title: Find the item type of an array
prompt: Write the conditional type `ItemOf<T>`. When `T` is an array, it is the array's item type: `ItemOf<string[]>` is `string`. Any other type stays as it is: `ItemOf<number>` is `number`. Only the type is checked.
hints: `T extends X ? A : B` picks `A` when `T` fits `X`, else `B`.
`infer U` names a type inside the pattern, as in `(infer U)[]`.
When `T` is not an array, give back `T` itself.

wrongAnswers.misconception: Gives `unknown` for arrays instead of the item type.
Gives `never` for non-arrays instead of the type itself.

feedback: `T extends X ? A : B` picks `A` when `T` fits `X`, else `B`.
